messages.subject: Colors Inside Legend
parts:
Dear All,
Please see the snippet at the end of the email.
I am generating a simple plot with a theme_rect() background. However,
the symbols in the legend (i.e. the two colored lines) are still shown
on a light gray background.
Once again, this must be a one-liner, but how do I change that gray to
white in order to be consistent with the rest of the theme?
Many thanks

Lorenzo

############################################
############################################
############################################


library(ggplot2)
library(Cairo)

x_dat <- c(seq(10),seq(10))
y_dat <- c(seq(10),3*seq(10))
g_dat <- c(rep(1,10),rep(2,10))
g_col <- c(rep("a",10),rep("b",10))


my_data <- cbind(as.data.frame(x_dat),as.data.frame(y_dat))

names(my_data) <- c("x","y")
my_data$gr <- factor(g_dat)

my_data$col <- g_col

cols <- c("a" = "black","b" = "red")

p1 <- ggplot(my_data, aes(x = x, y = y, group = gr, colour = col))+
geom_line()+
scale_colour_manual("Two variables",labels=c("a","b"),
breaks=c("a","b"), values=cols) +
opts(panel.background=theme_rect(fill="white"))+
opts(panel.grid.minor = theme_blank())+
opts(panel.grid.major = theme_blank())+
opts(legend.position = c(0.64, 0.7))+
opts( legend.background=theme_rect(fill='white'))


CairoPDF("Test_legend2.pdf")
print(p1)
dev.off()

messages.subject: Re: Colors Inside Legend
parts:
Hi,

You probably want to change the legend.key option of theme_grey(),

p1 <- ggplot(my_data, aes(x = x, y = y, group = gr, colour = col)) +
  geom_line()+
  scale_colour_manual("Two variables",labels=c("a","b"),
                      breaks=c("a","b"),  values=cols) +

opts(panel.background=theme_rect(fill="white"),
panel.grid.minor = theme_blank(),
panel.grid.major = theme_blank(),
legend.position = c(0.64, 0.7),
legend.background=theme_rect(fill='white'),
legend.key = theme_rect(colour = NA))


HTH,

baptiste
